name: @musicapp/desktop
description: Split songs into stems and practice along
author: Stemify

scripts.pack: npm run bundle && npm run python && node scripts/base-id.mjs && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64
scripts.dist: npm run bundle && npm run python && node scripts/base-id.mjs && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.pack:win: npm run bundle && bash scripts/prepare-python.sh win && node scripts/base-id.mjs && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run bundle && bash scripts/prepare-python.sh win && node scripts/base-id.mjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
